knowledge.plain_language_summary: A single-face SignComp #1391 extruded aluminum cabinet with slide-in retainers, a solar-grade polycarbonate face decorated with CNC-cut painted aluminum panels, plus separate non-illuminated laser-cut acrylic secondary letters.
knowledge.rationale: An extruded cabinet with slide-in retainers is serviceable; decorating a poly face with CNC aluminum panels gives a dimensional lit logo.

structure.construction: SignComp #1391 4in single-face extruded aluminum cabinet, #1694 slide-in retainers, 2x2x1/8in internal angle frame, 0.090in back, 0.150in translucent white polycarbonate face with CNC-cut 0.090in aluminum panels masked/painted, Principal 12V 5000K LEDs
laser-cut 1in acrylic, painted, flush-mounted with 3/16in allthread studs in silicone-filled holes

craft_observations: Slide-in retainers make the face serviceable; CNC aluminum panels on the poly face give dimensional lit logo.
